text:
Alex P (SE): kicking off OceanBank POC thread — customer requires BYO HSM for envelope encryption + runtime unwraps. Must support rotation <=1h for ephemeral session KEKs and provide signed provenance for every wrap/unwrap. They also want a capped monthly pricing option for very high QPS.
Jordan M (AE): pricing clarifying q — do we bill wrap/unwrap as key_ops separate from token usage? They want a predictable monthly cap and an option for prepaid blocks.
Alex P (SE): yes — wrap/unwrap = key_ops. We can propose: (A) per-op + monthly proxy fee, (B) prepaid block with burst overage, (C) private on-prem fixed fee. I'll draft numbers.
Li Wei (Security): SQ items: vendor attestation (FIPS level), SOC2 artifacts, proof that plaintext KEKs never leave customer HSM, and HSM vendor-signed attestation. Also want sample signed provenance events and retention policy for key-op logs.
Pri (SRE): attestation + perf: we can provide vendor attestation PDF and p50/p95/p99 for wrap/unwrap. Expect unwrap ~4-25ms + proxy hop. We'll HMAC-sign provenance events before forwarding. Default retention 90d, can extend.
Dana (Deal Ops): quote must include two variants (managed proxy in customer VPC, full private deployment), PS for ceremony facilitation (6-12h), and an optional insurance-facilitation add-on. Need clear SOW bullets for failure modes and emergency re-import.
Jordan M (AE): acceptance criteria for POC: 1) E2E encrypt/decrypt with their KEK, 2) rotation at <=1h with zero dropped requests, 3) 95p end-to-end gen latency <=180ms, 4) signed provenance and audit stream to their SIEM. Can we stream to Splunk HEC or S3?
Alex P (SE): yes — we can stream JSON events to Splunk HEC, Datadog, or S3. We'll include sample event schema and signing header.
Li Wei (Security): split-custody ask: they want a 2-person ceremony with neutral escrow storing only wrapped KEK. Can Redwood orchestrate without holding shards?
Pri (SRE): yes — Redwood can orchestrate and verify wrapped KEK hashes. We never persist unwrapped material. We'll publish verification hashes and a dry-run checklist.
Alex P (SE): quick config snippet for docs:
```
# bind customer key to proxy (mtls)
redwoodctl kms bind --mode byo --key-arn arn:custom:hsm:us-east-1:hk-888 \
  --proxy https://proxy.oceanbank.example --mtls-cert /etc/ob_cert.pem
```
Jordan M (AE): legal flagged indemnity: customer wants limited liability for BYOK. Legal will default to "customer retains custody risk" language; escalate if customer pushes further.
Dana (Deal Ops): I'll prepare the two-variant quote + PS lines and add prepaid-block pricing option. Will request attestation artifacts from infra and circulate draft SOW in 24h.
redwood-files-bot: uploaded artifact: oceanbank-poc/attestation_and_provenance_samples.zip
Alex P (SE): thanks — I'll follow up with sample log schema and per-op bands after finance sync. Closing loop in 24h. :white_check_mark:
